title: Matrix LR down-sweep (MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03)
description: Decreased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 (25% lower Muon LR for transformer matrix params), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005651, worse than the 1.002279 baseline and comparable in magnitude to round 2's regression from raising MATRIX_LR to 0.05 (~1.0058-1.006). This brackets MATRIX_LR=0.04 as a genuine local optimum from both directions -- further single-scalar LR sweeps on this axis should stop. Future rounds should move to a genuinely untested axis (e.g. WINDOW_PATTERN, HEAD_DIM, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE, or WEIGHT_DECAY) rather than more perturbations near the current baseline.
